items.title: Claude opens Skills over MCP in public beta and makes MCP Tasks and Elicitation generally available
items.summary: MCP servers can now ship their own skills alongside their tools, loaded only when needed, so Claude and Claude Code know how to use a server on connect. Tasks lets a server run long background jobs while Claude keeps working, and Elicitation lets a server pause for user sign-off; File Uploads is next.

doubt.pushback: A builder points out that skills shipped inside a server update with it, so the server owner can change the playbook Claude follows without the user ever seeing a diff.

reception.summary: Mostly enthusiastic restatements and builders saying their agents needed this; the one substantive concern was silent server-side skill changes steering the model.

items.title: LlamaIndex open-sources OCRia-1, a 4B VLM for document OCR
items.summary: LlamaIndex released open weights for OCRia-1, a 4B vision-language model for document OCR it places on the accuracy-cost Pareto curve among 4B models, a day after the 8.1M-parameter OCRia-nano-1. Community GGUF conversions appeared within hours, so it can already run in local runtimes.

reception.summary: No replies surfaced in the conversation search window beyond the announcement itself.

items.title: Cognition releases SWE-2.1, an RL-trained coding model on Kimi K3, with Lightning and Cyber variants
items.summary: SWE-2.1 is trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 and reportedly rises from 24.1% to 41.3% on FrontierCode 2.0 and from 24.2% to 50.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 versus SWE-2; a Lightning variant runs about 10x faster on Cerebras. It is free on Devin paid plans for two weeks.

doubt.pushback: Benchmarks are vendor-reported; repliers want to see whether they hold in practice after SWE-2 underwhelmed relative to its numbers.

reception.summary: Early replies were curious (why Kimi rather than Qwen or DeepSeek) and cautiously positive, with one skeptic asking whether the benchmark gains reflect real use.

items.title: ARC Prize verifies Gemini 4 Neon at 93.8% on ARC-AGI-2 for $0.32 a task; PostTrainBench ranks it #8
items.summary: ARC Prize's verified run puts Gemini 4 Neon at 93.8% on ARC-AGI-2 ($0.32 per task) and 98.5% on ARC-AGI-1 ($0.17), tied for fifth with Fable 5.2. Separately, PostTrainBench added Neon at #8, level with Gemini 4 Carbon.

reception.summary: No replies surfaced in the conversation search window.

items.title: OpenAI: two amateur astronomers used Codex and GPT-6.2 Astra to find candidate exoplanet signals in public telescope data
items.summary: OpenAI describes two hobbyists who independently searched public survey data with Codex and Astra and flagged signals that could indicate planets. The finds are candidates, not confirmed planets.

doubt.pushback: A reply notes one search flagged 200+ signals including about 10 already-confirmed Kepler planets, and confirmation of new ones could take months or years.

reception.summary: Some enthusiasm about citizen science with AI over public data, some hostility toward OpenAI, and one specific caution that the signals are unconfirmed candidates.

items.title: Datalab ships Indra OCR 1.2: 1M-parameter recognizer on CPU, 50 ms a page on 32 cores, 78.9 on OmniParseBench
items.summary: Indra OCR 1.2 runs on CPU with a 1M-parameter main recognizer, about 7x faster than Tesseract, and Datalab reports it beats DeepSeek-OCR-2 on its benchmark, with LaTeX math, better tables and word boxes.

doubt.pushback: Comparison is on the vendor's own benchmark.

items.title: Baseten and Harvey post-train four US open-weight models on legal agent tasks; Muse Spark Open hits 30.3% all-pass
items.summary: Post-training Meta, NVIDIA, Reflection and Thinking Machines open-weight models on long-horizon legal work lifted all four above 20% all-pass on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark, and post-trained Muse Spark Open reached 30.3%, above every closed model they evaluated.

doubt.pushback: Benchmark and evaluation are run by the partners themselves.

items.title: Arena launches a 3D leaderboard in Code Arena; Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 1933
items.summary: Code Arena now ranks models on generating 3D scenes by head-to-head votes; first scores put Claude Fable 5.2 (1933) and Opus 5.5 (1915) ahead of GPT-6.2 Sol (1869).

items.title: Google Workspace MCP servers and gwscli go GA with a free one-click personal mode
items.summary: Eight official MCP servers (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat, Tasks) plus the gwscli tool are generally available without an Enterprise plan or billing card, with 5,000 requests a day per product free and built-in human approval for sends.

items.title: ByteDance Seed TTS 3.0 available on fal: 100+ languages with pace, pitch and volume control
items.summary: ByteDance's Seed TTS 3.0 can now be called through fal's API, generating speech in over 100 languages and variants with selectable voices and prosody controls.

items.title: TRL's async RL trainer is now stable, overlapping generation and learning to cut GPU idle time
items.summary: Hugging Face TRL's asynchronous RL trainer generates and trains at the same time instead of alternating, and the team reports large wall-clock savings for the same number of steps on 16 GPUs.

items.title: Hugging Face curates about 2,000 validated RL environments to train Qwen3.8-27B on agentic coding and knowledge work
items.summary: The team retrieved, cleaned and validated roughly 2k environments spanning coding, banking, law, consulting and business apps for RL post-training, and describes what made environments useful.

doubt.pushback: No dataset link or numbers in the post itself.

items.title: Hermes Agent v0.23.4 moves old dashboard and serve backends onto the new unified gateway in one command
items.summary: The release migrates existing hermes dashboard or hermes serve setups to the unified gateway on the same address and port, enabling the new web app ahead of a mobile app. Google DeepMind's Neon and Hydrogen models are also now in Nous Portal for use under Hermes Agent.

items.title: NVIDIA publishes a validated VeRL + vLLM container on NGC for RL training
items.summary: A prebuilt NGC image bundles VeRL and vLLM with tested dependencies so RL experiments start without environment setup.

items.title: Exa search API adds live structured flight data for agents
items.summary: Agents using Exa can now query 37M+ flights a year across 4,200 airports with live gate, delay and cancellation data.

items.title: NVIDIA tutorial trains an obstacle-avoidance controller for the Microduck robot in Isaac Lab and Newton
items.summary: The walkthrough trains a navigation policy in simulation on top of a fixed walking policy, then tests it on the small physical robot.

items.title: WorldLatent: a unified 4D latent space for world perception and generation
items.summary: A paper proposing one 4D latent representation shared by world perception and generation models.

doubt.pushback: Paper link only; no code or numbers in the post.

items.title: Dynamic-allocation quantization of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 reports 37 to 49% lower KL than ExLlamaV3
items.summary: An automatic quantization algorithm with dynamic weight allocation beats EXL3 on its own KL benchmark for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, without hand tuning.

doubt.pushback: Early result, no release link yet.

items.title: TokenSpeed reports a new throughput-interactivity frontier for Kimi K3.1 Pro on eight AMD MI355X GPUs
items.summary: Running the full SemiAnalysis AgentX trace, TokenSpeed claims the leading measured curve from latency-first to throughput-first serving on MI355X.

items.title: SAGE-EXL3 recipe runs Inkling 2 Mini on a DGX Spark at 108.8 tok/s in about 27 GB
items.summary: A community EXL3 quantization recipe reports 108.8 tokens/s on one DGX Spark with 98.33% top-1 agreement to the full model and 26 to 27 GB peak memory.

doubt.pushback: Single-author benchmark; recipe link not opened.

items.title: OpenAI begins rolling out a combined Chat and Work experience to a small group of ChatGPT Pro users
items.summary: OpenAI is testing a merged chat and agentic work interface with some Pro users before a broader rollout.

doubt.pushback: Limited rollout, no docs or details on what changes.
